arg.name: ego
arg.description: aib ego config (EgoConfig YAML: rig, domain, body, ...)

arg.name: world
arg.description: a map's isaac/world.yaml, or a USD; empty: a ground plane

arg.name: map_pose
arg.description: x,y,z,yaw of base_link in the map frame (m, rad)

arg.name: pose
arg.description: or x,y,z,yaw in the world frame

arg.name: render
arg.description: auto (a window when DISPLAY is set), window or headless

arg.name: view
arg.description: with a window: chase (the viewport follows the ego) or free

arg.name: realtime
arg.description: pace the world to the wall clock

node.name: isaac_vehicle_runner
node.args: --ego=$(var ego) --world=$(var world) --map-pose=$(var map_pose) --pose=$(var pose) --render=$(var render) --view=$(var view) --realtime=$(var realtime)
